dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Oh, isn't this a letter for Mr. Flins? What's it doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Ah, I get it now... I can't believe you, old man. Even if you sent me, there's no way Flins would accept that puppy you're trying to give him.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Speaking of which... It's been a while since I last dropped in on him.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I should pick a route near Paha Isle next time I go on patrol.
